_doc: Sapphire FLAG_*/VAR_* -> Black 2 saved flag/work ids. Generated and kept by converter/gen_story_ids.py (see its docstring); "ids" are FIXED once given.

VAR_LITTLEROOT_HOUSES_STATE.note: read in Brendan's house (a girl meets his mom; Sapphire name)

VAR_LITTLEROOT_HOUSES_STATE_2.note: read in May's house (a boy meets her mom; Sapphire name)

VAR_LITTLEROOT_STATE.note: 0 twin guards the north exit, 1 met the rival, 2 twin asked for help

VAR_MAUVILLE_OLD_MAN.note: 0 not chosen yet, 1-5 Bard/Hipster/Trader/Storyteller/Giddy (random once per save)

VAR_STARTER_MON.note: Black 2's own starter index var (0/1/2), same meaning

FLAG_EXP_SHARE_ON.note: Gen 6 Exp. Share switched on (b2tools/patches/exp_share.py reads it)

FLAG_HIDE_BIRCH_BATTLE_POOCHYENA.note: Route 101: Birch and the Poochyena chasing him

FLAG_HIDE_MOM_UPSTAIRS.note: Mom on the player's 2F (comes up after the clock is set)

VAR_HOENN_DIVE_X.note: dive agent: arrival/surfacing tile x, written by the dive lookup code (b2tools/patches/dive.py)

VAR_HOENN_DIVE_Z.note: dive agent: arrival/surfacing tile z (the dive lookup code; consecutive with _X and _ZONE)

VAR_HOENN_DIVE_ZONE.note: dive agent: zone the dive/surfacing leads to (the dive lookup code)

FLAG_TV_SHOW_RECENT_HAPPENINGS_PENDING.note: ch3a: Sapphire's RECENT_HAPPENINGS TV show recorded by the Oceanic Museum 1F reporter (InterviewAfter); Black 2 has no TV shows, so it stays pending: InterviewBefore = this flag

FLAG_TV_SHOW_FAN_CLUB_LETTER_PENDING.note: ch3a: Sapphire's FAN_CLUB_LETTER TV show (Slateport Fan Club reporter, lead Pokemon without a nickname); InterviewBefore = this flag

FLAG_TV_SHOW_FAN_CLUB_OPINIONS_PENDING.note: ch3a: Sapphire's PKMN_FAN_CLUB_OPINIONS TV show (Slateport Fan Club reporter, nicknamed lead Pokemon); InterviewBefore = this flag

VAR_BERRY_PICKED_0.note: daily berry spots 1-14 picked today (bit k-1: spot k), cleared on the first pick of a day (converter/gen_hidden_items.py)

VAR_BERRY_PICKED_1.note: daily berry spots 15-28 picked today (bit k-1: spot k), cleared on the first pick of a day (converter/gen_hidden_items.py)

VAR_BERRY_PICKED_2.note: daily berry spots 29-42 picked today (bit k-1: spot k), cleared on the first pick of a day (converter/gen_hidden_items.py)

VAR_BERRY_PICKED_3.note: daily berry spots 43-56 picked today (bit k-1: spot k), cleared on the first pick of a day (converter/gen_hidden_items.py)

VAR_BERRY_PICKED_4.note: daily berry spots 57-70 picked today (bit k-1: spot k), cleared on the first pick of a day (converter/gen_hidden_items.py)

VAR_BERRY_PICKED_5.note: daily berry spots 71-84 picked today (bit k-1: spot k), cleared on the first pick of a day (converter/gen_hidden_items.py)

FLAG_DAILY_BERRY_SPOTS.note: clear = no berry spot picked yet today (Black 2 clears it at midnight): the next pick clears VAR_BERRY_PICKED_* (2792: no Black 2 script uses it)

FLAG_GABBY_AND_TY_QUOTE.note: ch4 (new): Gabby & Ty hold a quote from the last interview (Sapphire gabbyAndTyData.quote != 0xffff; GabbyAndTyGetLastQuote)

VAR_GABBY_AND_TY_BATTLE_NUM.note: ch4 (new): Sapphire gabbyAndTyData.battleNum (GabbyAndTyGetBattleNum: where Gabby & Ty stand next, Route 111/118/120)

FLAG_ITEM_ABANDONED_SHIP_HIDDEN_FLOOR_RO.note: the Scanner's item ball on the Abandoned Ship's hidden floor (a key item converter/gen_items.py leaves to the story; Sapphire's item-ball flag name)

VAR_PACIFIDLOG_TM_RECEIVED_DAY.note: Pacifidlog's weekly TM: the day count it was given on (Sapphire keeps it in the save outside the vars: SetPacifidlogTMReceivedDay)

VAR_LOTTERY_ID.note: ch8a: the one ID number every Pokemon the player owns shares for the Lottery Corner (Black 2 scripts cannot read OT IDs); 0 = not drawn yet

VAR_FANCLUB_UNKNOWN_1.note: Sapphire name: Lilycove Fan Club state (bits 0-6 counter, bit 7 initialized, bits 8-15 the eight fans that moved to the player)

VAR_FANCLUB_UNKNOWN_2.note: Sapphire name: Lilycove Fan Club, play-time hours at the last update

FLAG_HIDE_WEATHER_INSTITUTE_BOY.note: ch7 (new): the wandering boy of the Weather Institute 1F is hidden while Team Aqua holds it (Sapphire moves object 5 to the bed with setobjectxyperm while VAR_WEATHER_INSTITUTE_STATE is 0; Black 2 can't change an NPC's movement, so the sleeping boy is a second entity); the zone init sets/clears it

FLAG_ITEM_MOSSDEEP_STEVENS_HOUSE_HM08.note: Steven's house: the Dive ball's hide flag (item-ball flag of Sapphire's map.json, no id from gen_items); set while the game is not cleared (Mossdeep zone init), cleared by the Hall of Fame (Ch11: EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_EventScript_ShowHM08) when HM08 was never received

VAR_MOSSDEEP_SPACE_CENTER_START_DAY.note: day of the year (1-366) of the first visit to Mossdeep: Sapphire's GetWeekCount counts weeks since the clock was set; Black 2 scripts only read the date (RTCGetDate), so the launch counter counts from the first visit

FLAG_DAILY_SHOAL_ITEMS_RESET.note: midnight-reset flag (Black 2 clears 2720-2819 each night): set = Shoal Cave's salt and shells were already made available again today (Sapphire: FLAG_SYS_SHOAL_ITEM is SET by each new day; the old man's script clears it and the 8 FLAG_HIDE_TOOK_SHOAL_*)

FLAG_E4_BATTLE_PENDING.note: Ch11: set before an Elite Four / Champion battle, cleared when it is won; the Pokemon League lobby's zone init runs Sapphire's ResetEliteFour when it is still set (a lost battle: Black 2 has no whiteout hook)

FLAG_NEW_MAUVILLE_REDRAW.note: fixups2: set by New Mauville's switch scripts just before the redraw map change (fade + MapChangeCore to the player's own tile), read and cleared by the zone init so that the redraw does not reset the barrier layout (a normal entry resets it, as Sapphire's OnTransition clears VAR_TEMP_1/2); claimed from Ch6's reserve

FLAG_DAILY_EM_REMATCHES.note: Emerald rematches: clear = a new day since the 'fought today' bits were cleared (emerald_rematch.c clears VAR_EM_REMATCH_DONE_*, then sets it)

VAR_EM_REMATCH_DONE_0.note: Emerald rematches: rows 0-15 of data/emerald/hoenn_rematch.json fought today (bit = row % 16)

VAR_EM_REMATCH_DONE_1.note: Emerald rematches: rows 16-31 of data/emerald/hoenn_rematch.json fought today (bit = row % 16)

VAR_EM_REMATCH_DONE_2.note: Emerald rematches: rows 32-47 of data/emerald/hoenn_rematch.json fought today (bit = row % 16)

VAR_EM_REMATCH_DONE_3.note: Emerald rematches: rows 48-63 of data/emerald/hoenn_rematch.json fought today (bit = row % 16)

VAR_EM_REMATCH_DONE_4.note: Emerald rematches: rows 64-79 of data/emerald/hoenn_rematch.json fought today (bit = row % 16)

VAR_EM_REMATCH_LEADERS.note: Emerald rematches: 2 bits per Gym Leader (gym n: bits 2n-2..2n-1) = rematch tiers beaten, 0-3 (notes/EMERALD_REMATCH.md)

VAR_EM_REMATCH_POSTGAME.note: Emerald rematches: 2 bits per post-game rematch row (data/emerald/hoenn_rematch.json gym 9 + n: bits 2n..2n+1; 9 = Wally at Victory Road) = rematch tiers beaten, 0-3

FLAG_EM_MIRAGE_TOWER_KEEP.note: Emerald Mirage Tower: set = the next zone init of Route 111's zone 370 keeps the tower as its cell is drawn (no roll); set by Route 112's zone init (its seam draws the tower's cell first) and by the desert part zone 610's, cleared by zone 370's and Mauville's (scenes/emerald/Route111_Mirage.inc)

WORK_MAP_REPLACE_0_MIRAGE_TOWER.note: work 0x4031 = map-replacement event 0 (condition 3, work 0x4031 == 0x1220): Emerald's Route 111 WITHOUT the Mirage Tower (data/emerald/hoenn_world.json alt_layouts Route111 = LAYOUT_ROUTE111_NO_MIRAGE_TOWER; src/field_scripts/scenes/emerald/Route111_Mirage.inc; emerald_ch9_mirage 2026-10-12).
